description: Messinaservizi Bene Comune publishes municipal waste-collection statistics through the Municipality of Messina's catalogue. The source describes quantities in kilograms, separated by month, year, waste type and European waste classification code, CER. One CSV is described as covering data from 2016 onwards, alongside annual PDF reports for 2018, 2020 and 2021. The end of the CSV series has not been verified from observations. These collection quantities can provide demand and performance inputs for waste-service capacity planning. They do not identify vehicle routes, collection frequency at individual addresses or available treatment capacity. Access is public and free under Creative Commons Attribution; no licence version is stated. Metadata refresh dates must not be substituted for the latest measured period. The related Messina waste-destination-facilities resource describes physical receiving sites, while this dataset records collection quantities; a facility-level allocation is not established.
